test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 20 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

All oranges are mangoes.

No mango is a banana.

Conclusions:

(I) No banana is a mango.

(II) All mangoes are oranges.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4b059ab6e20eb41c33ca61a0b19bdbcdbc2e2dbcd27dcadacf36c2c646eb738.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) No banana is a mango → Follow (As no mango is a banana. As direct relation is given between mangoes and banana, therefore it is true)

(II) All mangoes are oranges→ **Does not** follow (As all oranges are mangoes. So it is possible but not definite)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
